The '''Londor system''' was located in the [[Londori sector/Legends|Londori sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was connected by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Ariarch system|Ariarch]], [[Valrar system/Legends|Valrar]], [[Darkon system/Legends|Darkon]], and [[Glee Anselm system/Legends|Glee Anselm systems]].<ref name="EGtW" /> It was the site of the [[Londori Mental Facility]].<ref name="Creatures" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the Londor system lay within territory controlled by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Londor system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square J-7.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The first update to the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to ''The Essential Atlas'' erroneously listed the Londor system as being located in grid square J-6, as part of the [[Dantus sector/Legends|"Gantus" sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="EAOCupdate1">See [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion/Update001|this preserved version]] of the first update of the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].</ref> a misspelling of the Outer Rim's Dantus [[Sector/Legends|sector]], in part located at those same coordinates. Later updates of the Online Companion corrected this error.<ref name="EAOC" />
